subject: english
stem: Which revision makes the mixed list easiest to agree with?
options: There are two pens and a notebook on the desk.
There is two pens and a notebook on the desk.
There are a notebook and one pen only is.

optionRationales.reason: There are two pens and a notebook on the desk.：複數項置前使 are 與清單整體更清楚。
There is two pens and a notebook on the desk.：is 與緊接的複數不一致。
There are a notebook and one pen only is.：謂語重複且語序錯誤。
There be pen notebook two.：缺少時態與正常語序。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依存在物核心名詞的數與事件時間，選擇 there is/are 或 there was/were，並在多項清單中保持資訊精確。」可推出 There are two pens and a notebook on the desk.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 There are two pens and a notebook on the desk. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
